_doc: Kirk round 18 call 1: uncertainty for the embed 'Debut vs UFC veteran' box. Rebuilt the exact published research.json set (debut_vs_vet, 233 bouts: the fresh build's 234 minus 2025-02-08 Rongzhu vs Kody Steele, added by the round-7 matcher fix). Win-rate CI: normal approximation. ROI CI: per-bet returns, 1u flat at the all-books closing price. Margin: expected ROI if the no-vig close were the true chance.
roi_ci_method: normal approximation: roi +/- 1.96 x SD/sqrt(n) of the 233 per-bet returns (this is what the box shows)
bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of the 233 per-bet returns, percentiles 2.5/97.5, seed 20261112 (round 19 check)
roi_ci_shown: roi_ci_boot_cards: bets on one card are correlated, so the box shows the card-clustered bootstrap (Kirk round 20 D)
